# ANAN

> ANAN is a Bangladesh-focused online marketplace connecting shoppers with approved sellers. The storefront supports English and Bangla experiences and displays prices in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT).

## Public pages
- Homepage: https://anan.com/
- Product catalogue: https://anan.com/products
- Categories: https://anan.com/categories
- Seller applications: https://anan.com/sell

## Public catalogue
- Product detail pages use the path pattern: https://anan.com/products/{product-slug}
- Storefront pages use the path pattern: https://anan.com/stores/{store-slug}
- Only products and sellers approved for public listing should be treated as available marketplace listings.
- Product availability, stock, price and delivery eligibility may change. Verify current details on the live product page before relying on them.

## Marketplace information
- Marketplace currency: BDT (৳).
- Initial market: Bangladesh.
- The marketplace supports multiple independent sellers.
- Seller applications are subject to administrative review; submitting an application does not mean a seller is approved.

## Language and accessibility
- English and Bangla are supported content languages.
- Use the language available on each page and preserve Bangla product names and descriptions when present.

## Policies and contact
- Refer to the live website for current terms, privacy, delivery, returns and support information.
- Do not infer unpublished policies, seller credentials, product claims or inventory.

## Crawling guidance
- Prefer canonical public URLs.
- Do not crawl or expose account, authentication, cart, checkout, seller dashboard, admin or API routes.
- Do not reproduce personal, order, payment, seller verification or other non-public information.
